_description: Test vectors for the compressed uint256 codec (docs/U256_COMPRESSED_CODEC.md). Generated with the normative Python reference implementation from that document. 'encode' vectors are canonical: encode(value) == hex and decode(hex) == (value, len). 'per_format_code' covers every assigned format byte 0..252 once. 'decode_only' inputs decode to 'value' but a canonical encoder never emits them. 'invalid' inputs must be rejected. Values are decimal strings; encodings are lowercase hex.

edge_cases.note: 1.23... ETH — dusty, falls back to literal

decode_only.note: 42 as a padded 2-byte literal; canonical is 1-byte
0 as a 1-byte literal; canonical is the empty literal 00
10^27 as 10*10^26; canonical uses the lowest exponent, 100*10^25
128*10 for 1280; the equal-length base-256 form 5*256 is canonical

invalid.note: literal announces 5 payload bytes, only 2 present
code 187 = (base 256, exp 1, L=1) with no mantissa byte
code 114 = (base 10, exp 11, L=4) with a 3-byte mantissa
